**Finding: missing (critical) — no indemnification anywhere in the Agreement.**

- Searches for "indemnif", "hold harmless", "defend" and "infringe" returned nothing; a full read of Section 9 (Warranties) and Section 10 (General Provisions) confirms there is no defence, indemnity or hold-harmless obligation running in either direction. Section 7.2's mutual advertising covenant and the Section 8 confidentiality obligations carry no indemnity, and there is no limitation-of-liability section either.
- HDI builds, hosts and distributes the Site and supplies the platform, software and administration tools, so the absence of any HDI IP-infringement indemnity leaves us fully exposed to third-party claims on infrastructure we do not control — this fails even the fallback position and sits in walk-away territory.
- Redline validated (ok:true) and submitted: new **Section 9(c)** inserted after p0058, requiring HDI to defend and indemnify the Company and its affiliates for (1) IP infringement/misappropriation claims relating to the Site, Services or HDI-provided materials (carved out where the claim arises from Company-supplied Content or Marks), (2) HDI's breach of law, (3) HDI-caused unauthorised access to or disclosure of Content, user information or Company data, and (4) HDI's gross negligence or wilful misconduct, with standard notice, defence-control (consent required for settlements binding us) and cooperation mechanics.
- Deliberately no reciprocal Company indemnity was added; the Company-side carve-out for our own Content and Marks is the concession offered if HDI pushes back.
